en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 2. My father (RA) said: `Ali ibn Ibrahim said, on the authority of Muhammad ibn `Isa ibn `Ubayd, on the authority of Yunus ibn `Abd al-Rahman, on the authority Hisham ibn al-Hakam that I asked Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) about the expression `Glory be to Allah.’
Thus, he (AS) replied, “Pride belongs to Allah, the Mighty and High.”
